jobs.description: As a Care Worker (Verzorgende IG) in Bladel, you will provide dedicated elderly care in a welcoming, small-scale residential setting with 21 apartments. Employment conditions follow the Dutch CAO VVT. Interested in meaningful elderly care where your contribution matters? Apply for this Verzorgende IG position in Bladel through WIJ.ZORGEN. For information, call 085 060 3432.
